question: What name did Rachel give her son as she was dying, and what did Jacob call him instead?
options: She called him Ben-Oni, but Jacob named him Benjamin
She called him Joseph, but Jacob named him Israel
She called him Benjamin, but Jacob named him Ben-Oni
She called him Reuben, but Jacob named him Levi
explanation: As she died, Rachel named her son Ben-Oni, meaning son of my trouble, but his father called him Benjamin.
